name: Gano Tarou
source: Tarou gives the impression of a skinhead, but in fact he's a very responsible worker of the "S.B.YAMATO" corporation, which is developing the advanced models of swimsuits. Despite the seriousness of his post, he's not deprived of a sense of humor.
